title: Attention, as a tool answer carries it (the `attention` field)
description: What waits for the player or changed since the caller last looked: the attention rows of the event log (events/row) as GateKit.Bridge.AttentionReader compacts them. A tool's answer schema refers to it as {"$ref": "common/attention"}.

seq.description: The row's seq in its side's log; absent for what is waiting.

waiting.description: Present when this waits for the player now.

what.description: The row's kind: dialogue, roll, reaction, box, combat_started, death, loading, job_done, ... (events/row).

choices.description: What can be chosen; shaped by `what`.

job.description: The GK.Act job it belongs to.

trader.description: The trader of a trade window.

answers.description: The answers of a dialogue line.

check.description: A roll: the check as the window names it.

skill.description: A roll: the skill or ability.

modifiers.description: A roll: the listed modifiers, { name, value }.

bonus.description: A roll: the sum of the modifiers, or { low, high }.

natural.description: A roll that ended: the die that counts.

total.description: A roll that ended: the die and the bonus.

success.description: A roll that ended: whether it passed.

critical.description: A roll that ended on a natural 20 or 1.

after.description: what = dropped: the caller had been told up to this seq of the side ...

first.description: ... and the oldest row kept is this one: the rows between went untold.

withheld.description: what = unplaced: a fair server did not give the rows of `kind` (no registry places them; `error` says why).
